baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated qawm-to-qawm and women-to-women constructions are interrupted twice by the possibility that the mocked party is better.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mockery subjects another to the speaker's purpose and turns peer groups into a one-sided valuation scene. The two possibility clauses reopen the comparison, so the attempted ranking cannot settle worth.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something under command for a purpose supplies the coercive action: the target is made to serve the mocker's elevation.
Valuation and pricing turn the repeated group pairing into an attempted social appraisal.
A hoped return after apparent lack supplies latent value that may reappear and reverse the present estimate.
Chosen excellence supplies the very comparative worth that ridicule falsely claims to have measured.

changed_reading.before: A ban on making jokes at another group's expense.
changed_reading.after: A ban on manufacturing rank by coercively pricing another group when the socially discounted party may carry the greater excellence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct object in 'do not lamz your selves' and the reciprocal nickname construction make aggressor and target members of one grammatical self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covert fault-finding becomes a push against the living collective, while reciprocal appellation fixes the jab into a public identifying mark. The community is both the hand that strikes and the body struck.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the extraction and circulation of a defect.
Pushing or striking gives the verbal fault a bodily force against the shared self.
The living self makes the reflexive object more than an idiom: communal injury reaches a life-bearing body.
A visible identifying mark supplies the persistence by which a passing jab becomes a social label.

changed_reading.before: Do not insult fellow believers because they are like yourselves.
changed_reading.after: Fault-finding and reciprocal labeling are recursive self-injury: a member pushes a wound into the collective body and leaves it there as an identifying mark.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'bad is the name, fusuq, after faith' places designation, boundary exit, temporal succession, and prior security together.
baseline_models.mechanism: A name raises and fixes a designation; fusuq supplies an image of something breaking out of its peel. After faith's security, abusive moral naming can therefore be read as stripping a person into an exposed deviant identity rather than merely describing an act.

activation_trace.role: A name as raised designation supplies the public identity assigned to the person.
A visible identifying mark makes designation adhere as a readable social trace.
A moist date emerging from its peel supplies boundary rupture and exposure.
Settled security and trust supply the protected identity from which the imposed deviance mark dislodges the person.
Afterness supplies an identity sequence, making the badness a replacement event after faith rather than a timeless label.

changed_reading.before: Fusuq is simply condemned as a bad name after faith.
changed_reading.after: The verse condemns an identity overwrite in which public naming strips a believer's secure designation and displays the person as what has broken out of its covering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing condition on repentance immediately names the non-returners as wrongdoers, after injuries committed against other people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wrong leaves a grievance, misplaces a person under an imposed label, and withholds the person's right to social standing. Repentance is consequently read as reopening redress, not only changing an inward feeling.

activation_trace.role: Calling another to repent keeps repentance socially answerable and open to an injured party's demand.
Grievance and the search for redress supply the unresolved claim left by verbal injury.
Concrete misplacement supplies the social wrong of fixing a person in an improper identity or position.
Withholding a right makes the injury a deprivation that repair must reverse.

changed_reading.before: The offender must privately repent or remain unjust.
changed_reading.after: Because ridicule and labeling generate a grievance and social misplacement, repentance remains incomplete as a merely private state; it points toward restored standing and redress.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from forbidden precedence to raised speech and then lowered voices supplies a vertical grammar for conduct. Ridicule becomes a verbal attempt to advance and rise in rank by forcing another downward.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful subjection anchors the downward force exerted on the mocked party.
Forward precedence supplies the unauthorized self-advancement later reproduced socially by ridicule.
Literal voice elevation supplies the audible vehicle of attempted status elevation.
Elevation of rank converts the spatial 'above' into the social hierarchy that mockery tries to stage.
Restraint through lowering supplies the opposite practice: reduce one's own projection rather than another's standing.

structural_cues: 49:1-3 moves in order from not advancing, to not raising speech above, to lowering one's own voice.
49:11 repeats peer-to-peer comparison and then destabilizes its hierarchy with two possibility clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forward precedence, raised and above speech, and restrained lowering; I infer that ridicule performs social elevation through verbal lowering of another. The live alternative is that the earlier vertical cues regulate prophetic etiquette only, making this transfer analogical.

changed_reading.before: Mockery expresses an already-held sense of superiority.
changed_reading.after: Mockery is itself a technology for producing superiority: the speaker advances and rises by making the target carry the downward position.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from hearts whose contents are disclosed by testing, through callers outside an enclosure, to patient waiting for emergence that would be better. The mocked person's greater worth can thus be presently enclosed, inward, or not yet emerged; ridicule judges from outside too early.

activation_trace.role: Hoped return supplies latent value that is absent from current view but not absent in reality.
A test that reveals what is in the heart locates decisive quality beneath public appearance.
An enclosed place supplies the boundary outside which impatient callers lack access.
Holding the self back supplies the temporal discipline required before evaluating what is concealed.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the delayed disclosure of worth.
Excellence appearing after patient emergence directly sharpens the focus verse's twice-withheld comparison.

structural_cues: 49:4-5 contrasts calling from outside the chambers with waiting until the addressed person comes out, and explicitly calls the latter better.
49:11 repeats 'perhaps they are better' for both social pairings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosed space, inward testing, restraint, emergence, and betterment; I infer that these spatial and temporal relations model socially hidden worth. The alternative is a narrower lesson about waiting for physical access, with no transfer to comparison in 49:11.

changed_reading.before: The mocker may simply be mistaken about which party is better.
changed_reading.after: The mocker commits premature disclosure: judging from outside before inward or future worth has had the conditions to emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: An insulting designation compresses a claim about a person into a portable report. The report sequence in 49:6 requires disclosure and clarification before a group is hit; focus labeling bypasses that gate, turns a suspected fault into a target, and leaves a durable aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the untested content that a label circulates as if established.
A report arriving and being transmitted supplies the social mobility of an accusation or nickname.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the verification gate that hostile designation skips.
Aimed impact supplies the causal conversion of an unchecked claim into injury against a target.
Absence of knowledge identifies the epistemic condition under which the targeting occurs.
A remaining trace supplies the persistence of harm after the speaker recognizes the mistake.

structural_cues: The branchless reciprocal naming construction at 49:11 words 27-28 supplies the compact designation event without licensing invented branch IDs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transmitted report, a clarification gate, ignorant targeting, and aftermath; I infer that a hostile label functions as a compressed report about identity. The alternative is that only propositional news, not appellations, falls under the report mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A nickname is also an unverified identity report: it packages a covert suspicion, bypasses clarification, and repeatedly re-aims the group at its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith is beautified in hearts and later described as entering them, while the focus name inventory supplies a public mark. Hostile naming is therefore a rival inscription: it freezes an exterior identity while inward moral formation remains hidden and dynamic.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the externally readable identity imposed by naming.
Making beauty manifest supplies an alternative inscription of faith that originates with God rather than peer branding.
The pure core of a thing locates the relevant formation beneath the public surface.
Entry into an interior makes faith a process of inward arrival rather than an identity peers can read off a label.

structural_cues: 49:7 places faith, adornment, hearts, and aversion to fusuq in one sequence.
49:14 distinguishes spoken profession from faith's entry into hearts, while 49:11 juxtaposes name, fusuq, and faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exterior marking, inner beautification, a core, and inward entry; I infer that abusive naming competes with God's hidden formation of identity. The alternative is that the inward and outward cues concern sincerity only and do not govern ordinary labels.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects ugly labels because they misdescribe believers.
changed_reading.after: It rejects peer branding as a rival identity-making process that hardens an exterior mark over an inward faith still being formed and disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The service branch of mockery and the gift branch of betterment make ridicule a one-sided status economy: the target performs unpaid labor for the mocker's claim of surplus merit. Context reverses ownership by locating favor with God and exposing recalled benefaction as a burden laid on its recipient.

activation_trace.role: Compelled unpaid service supplies the target's extraction as material for someone else's status gain.
Beneficence and gift keep genuine good in a giving rather than self-exalting economy.
Claiming surplus merit supplies the status assertion performed by the mocker.
Favor as a gift relocates excellence away from self-owned rank.
Reminding a beneficiary of a favor supplies the burdening transaction by which asserted goodness dominates another.
A gentle gift sent toward one held in affection supplies the non-coercive countereconomy.

structural_cues: 49:17 reverses the direction of human boasting by making guidance God's favor upon the speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unpaid service, claimed surplus, gift, burdensome reminder, and gentle giving; I infer that ridicule extracts status from another's humiliation. The live alternative is that the service branch is too distant from ordinary derision here, so this remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: Mockery spends a target's dignity for amusement.
changed_reading.after: Mockery conscripts the target into unpaid status labor, while the context denies the mocker ownership of the very surplus merit being claimed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two believing parties can turn against one another, yet remain bound as siblings requiring repair and rebalancing. The focus's group-to-group mockery and 'your selves' become a verbal form of factional conflict inside one body, with repentance oriented toward repaired relation.

activation_trace.role: The living self anchors the claim that opposing members still constitute one injured body.
Mutual combat between two sides supplies the escalated factional structure echoed by group-against-group speech.
Removing aversion between people supplies the relational repair required after verbal aggression.
Equivalence and matching supply the rebalancing that counters ridicule's manufactured hierarchy.
Sibling kinship supplies the durable relation that conflict does not erase and that makes injury reflexive.

structural_cues: 49:9-10 retains the name believers for opposed parties and then restates them as siblings requiring repair.
49:11 immediately shifts to group-against-group and uses 'your selves' as the object of fault-finding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two-sided combat, kinship, repair, and balancing; I infer a structural analogy between verbal faction-making and civil conflict, not a claim that every insult chronologically causes combat. The alternative is that 49:11 is only individual etiquette after a separate legal conflict rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse protects individuals from rude peers.
changed_reading.after: It interrupts factional conflict at the level of speech: group mockery is civil aggression within one sibling body, and its remedy must rebalance relation rather than merely silence words.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context lays out a material sequence from suspicion to hidden probing, absent mention, and consumption of a dead sibling's flesh. Focus fault-finding and naming fit an earlier crystallization point: an imagined defect is probed, extracted, and fixed as the portion by which the group consumes the person.

activation_trace.role: Covert fault-finding supplies the defect selected for extraction and circulation.
Suspicion as accusation supplies the unverified seed from which a fixed identity claim grows.
Secret tracking of a report supplies the probing stage that seeks material for the label.
Mentioning a person in absence supplies circulation without the bearer's ability to answer or change the mark.
Corruption and tale-bearing between people connect verbal circulation to social consumption.
Stripping flesh from bone supplies the reduction of a whole person to one consumable exposed feature.
Loss of life and agency supplies the target's inability to contest the identity consumed in absence.

structural_cues: 49:12 orders suspicion, spying, backbiting, eating, sibling flesh, and death in a single escalating image.
49:11 orders mockery, covert fault-finding, and reciprocal appellation before naming the shared self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accusation, covert probing, absent circulation, corruption between people, flesh-stripping, and lost agency; I infer a pipeline in which a label makes one fault socially consumable. The alternative is that the flesh image applies only to backbiting and should not be extended backward to ridicule or nicknames.

changed_reading.before: Mockery, fault-finding, nicknames, and backbiting are neighboring speech offenses.
changed_reading.after: They can form an extraction pipeline: suspicion selects a fault, probing isolates it, naming fixes it, and circulation consumes that fragment in place of the living person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created distinctions and collective names are relational infrastructure: peoples gather tribes, groups face one another, and marks enable recognition. Competitive claims to honor corrupt that infrastructure by turning a coordinate for encounter into a vertical verdict of worth.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark anchors the legitimate informational function that hostile appellation deforms.
Calling or naming a thing makes the creation of social groupings simultaneously an act of designation.
A people that gathers tribes supplies a higher grouping whose function includes connection, not only separation.
A group whose members face one another supplies reciprocal encounter rather than a ladder of rank.
Recognition after a trace or sign supplies the proper use of identity marks.
Competitive boasting in nobility supplies the corrupted use of difference that ridicule performs.

structural_cues: 49:13 pairs created sex difference with peoples and tribes, assigns mutual recognition as purpose, and relocates honor to a criterion at God.
The branchless appellation words at 49:11 words 27-28 are retained only as the structural naming cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, gathering groups, face-to-face relation, recognition by signs, and competitive nobility; I infer that identity categories are meant as coordinates for encounter and are corrupted when used as rank verdicts. The alternative is a narrower anti-boasting contrast without a general account of naming.

changed_reading.before: The verse bans derogatory group labels and the next verse celebrates diversity.
changed_reading.after: The focus protects the social infrastructure of naming itself: marks and group names should make mutual recognition possible, not convert created difference into competitive honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition can proceed from signs, but its inventory also contains the figure who claims hidden knowledge. Later speech can appropriate judgment over another, while the sequence reserves full disclosure of inward religion, unseen reality, and action to God. Mockery overreads a visible sign into a verdict on hidden worth.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and pricing anchor the human judgment of comparative worth being challenged.
The diviner who claims hidden knowledge supplies recognition's dangerous overreach into invisible states.
Speech that appropriates judgment over another supplies the act performed when a label becomes a verdict.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic standard human ranking cannot claim for itself.
What is screened from eyes supplies the hidden domain into which ridicule falsely projects certainty.
Insight of the heart supplies the penetrating sight attributed in the closing context, beyond peer observation.

structural_cues: 49:13 locates the decisive honor criterion 'at God'.
49:16 rejects informing God about religion, and 49:18 closes with knowledge of the unseen and sight of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-based recognition, pretended hidden knowledge, appropriated judgment, disclosure, unseen reality, and inward sight; I infer that ridicule usurps epistemic jurisdiction over worth. The alternative is that the closing knowledge formulas establish divine omniscience without directly reframing peer comparison.

changed_reading.before: The mocker makes a morally unreliable comparison.
changed_reading.after: The mocker acts as a counterfeit knower: a visible feature is overread into hidden worth, and a spoken label appropriates judgment that the surrounding sequence reserves to fuller knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant S-M-M mapping of the focus name root and crosses from poison and peel to social identity. It remains packet-valid because the split mapping is explicitly supplied, the focus juxtaposes name, fusuq, and faith, and 49:14 supplies inward entry. Render it only as a material analogy, never as a claim that the surface word for name literally means poison here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places name beside peel-breaking fusuq after faith; the context then describes faith as entering hearts.

activation_trace.role: Poison entering a body supplies the exploratory image of an imposed name penetrating the shared social self.
A date emerging from its peel supplies the opposite boundary movement: the marked person is exposed as outside.
Settled security supplies the protected communal condition disrupted by penetration and expulsion.
Entry into an interior supplies faith's proper inward motion against the label's invasive motion.
The heart supplies the interior body-space in which the two directional movements are contrasted.

changed_reading.before: A bad label sits on a person's surface.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the label behaves like a penetrant that enters the communal body and reverses faith's inward movement by pushing its bearer outward through an exposed deviance identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the warning about raised speech and collapsing deeds to the focus insult through wound imagery. It stays anchored in the focus's pushing lamz and grievance-bearing zulm, with packet branches for abusive hearing, wound relapse, and fine awareness. Render it as an asymmetry of hidden consequence, not as a legal claim that every insult automatically nullifies all deeds.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus gives fault-finding a pushing force and closes with an unresolved grievance when the speaker does not return.

activation_trace.role: Pushing or striking anchors speech as an impact rather than a vanishing sound.
A grievance seeking redress supplies the injury that persists beyond the utterance.
Making another hear ugly abuse makes the divine-hearing closure acoustically specific to verbal harm.
A wound relapsing and retaining a trace supplies the target-side persistence and speaker-side hidden loss.
Fine awareness supplies the faculty explicitly absent when the consequence develops below the speaker's notice.

changed_reading.before: The insult ends when its sound ends, though it may have offended someone.
changed_reading.after: The utterance can leave a relapsing trace in the target and a hidden collapse in the speaker's own moral work, with neither consequence proportionate to what the speaker noticed.

strongest_changes: Mockery shifted from an expression of rank to a mechanism that manufactures rank by subjecting and pricing another.
A nickname became both an unverified identity report and an exterior mark competing with inward faith formation.
The shared-self grammar, sibling context, and repair sequence turned verbal injury into factional self-harm requiring relational redress.
Created group names shifted from neutral categories to recognition infrastructure that ridicule corrupts into competitive honor.
The final knowledge sequence exposed ridicule as an overclaim to hidden judgment rather than merely an inaccurate opinion.
summary.what_was_special: The split name inventory allowed designation and visible marking to coexist with a contained penetrant image, while the context moved through vertical speech, report verification, inner formation, repair, material consumption, recognition, and unseen knowledge without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The vertical and unpaid-service readings depend on analogical transfer from speech etiquette and distant branches, though both remain visibly anchored in mockery and comparison.
The peel, poison, and inward-entry model is materially coherent but branch-distant and must remain exploratory.
The concealed-worth model leaves open whether the better party's value is inward, temporally emergent, socially unseen, or all three.
The report and flesh pipelines may describe adjacent speech offenses rather than one causal sequence in every case.
